description: ST unit auxiliary transformer 15.75/10.5 kV 16 MVA
remarks: Plant aux load SRC-NG-100 10.30 MW (AL-01..22 excl. GSU losses AL-08/09), LDO case about 10.9 MW, MAX case 9.70 MW; design MV bus load 11.1 MW incl. AL-21 losses = 12.6 MVA at pf 0.88, +10 % = 13.9 MVA (765 A at 10.5 kV). 16 MVA = 115 % of design load; CW pump start (2 MW x 6 = 14 MVA) with one UAT out: bus Ssc 160 MVA (uk 10 %) gives dip about 9 %, acceptable; uk 10 % = 8.8 kA at 10.5 kV.
service: ST unit auxiliary transformer 15.75/10.5 kV (ST generator terminals to MV section B)
